label: flat everywhere — transfer not demonstrated
result: We gave the big multi-size training loop one round with the new recipe. All six of its exams stayed level with the ordinary round. The new-board exam also stayed level: 174 vs 177. The mature loop already scores as well on new boards as our best experiment.
conclusion: The recipe neither helped nor hurt the mature loop after one round. It stays recommended for new or generalization-focused training loops only. Practical note: on 8-robot boards, the extra data collection runs about six times slower.
